description: July 30, 2024 Today, July 30, the Indiana State Board of Education (SBOE) held another public hearing about the new, proposed high school diplomas: GPS Diploma and GPS Diploma Plus. The meeting allowed educators, parents, students and legislators to provide feedback on the new requirements.&nb

title: Hamilton testifies on proposed diploma requirements — Carey Hamilton
